title: Four reasons to run your agents on AiR
lead: Privacy, real-time voice, customers from messengers and from your own website, and full control over what you spend on AI.

encryption.title: MasterKey encryption
encryption.desc: The encryption key is derived from your MasterKey password and available only to you. We do not store that key and cannot recover your data.

points.a: Every stored record — keys, tokens, conversations
points.b: In production the services never log your data
points.c: Only you know the password — there is no “reset via support”

realtime.title: Real-time voice and cloning
realtime.desc: Inbound and outbound calls right inside the messengers. Voice agents answer with minimal latency.

points.c: Voice cloning that matches your brand

leads.title: Automated lead discovery
leads.desc: The agent searches for clients on a schedule across Telegram and WhatsApp, then qualifies them by voice or text. The inbound flow comes straight from your website.

points.a: Runs on a schedule, no manual trigger
points.b: Chat widget for any website — air_widget

byok.title: Bring your own API keys (BYOK)
byok.desc: You pay the AI provider directly with your own keys. The $1 per month covers infrastructure only.

points.a: No token markup — and it is structurally impossible
points.c: Limits and billing stay on your side
